email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Operational Care Specialist Sea Logistics position at Kuehne+Nagel in Antwerp. With a background in logistics at Katoen Natie and a strong technical foundation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your Sea Logistics team.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer, I have developed strong organizational and analytical skills, managing multiple projects and meeting tight deadlines. My experience in a high-volume logistics environment at Katoen Natie taught me the importance of accuracy and efficiency, which I believe are crucial for this role. I am fluent in English, have a B1 level in Dutch, and am based in Zwijndrecht, close to Antwerp.

I am eager to bring my dedication and structured approach to Kuehne+Nagel, ensuring compliant and efficient transport solutions for your customers. I am confident that my skills and enthusiasm make me a great fit for your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your company.

Sincerely,
